rows.title: Server-owned evidence only
rows.defect: the authority of the record is not checked, so a client upload is taken as the provider's
rows.test: a client upload makes no card

rows.title: Anchored billing dates
rows.defect: the day is not clamped to the month's last day, so Jan 31 rolls into March

rows.title: Every term on the card
rows.defect: what the person loses and when is not required
rows.test: no card without what the person loses

rows.title: The review window
rows.defect: the last review day itself is counted as passed
rows.test: a card on the last review day

rows.title: An expired yes does nothing
rows.defect: the approval's own expiry is not checked
rows.test: an approval past its time is refused

rows.title: The owner's own yes
rows.defect: who approved is not checked, so a model's approval cancels
rows.test: a model's approval is not a yes

rows.title: A block is not a cancel
rows.defect: an active card block is recorded as the contract ending
rows.test: the contract stays active under a block

rows.title: Changed terms void the yes
rows.defect: only that a fresh card can be made is checked, not that its terms match
rows.test: a fee changed after the yes is refused

rows.title: A request is not a cancellation
rows.defect: a request is recorded as cancelled
rows.test: the contract stays active after the request

rows.title: Effective only after accepted
rows.test: an effective record before acceptance is refused

rows.title: Accepted on the agreed terms
rows.defect: the end date is not compared
rows.test: a later end date is refused

rows.title: Net of what is owed
rows.defect: what is still owed is left out of the costs

rows.title: A charge reopens the case
rows.defect: every window counts the renewal as avoided

rows.title: Refunds capped at the charge
rows.test: a cent more than the charge is refused

rows.title: Only posted refunds
rows.defect: a pending refund counts as received
rows.test: a pending refund is not cash
